items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: And, and at that time I was doing a lot of teaching and I guess I sold about a half dozen violins which he made.

ctx.x: What kind of violin did you have, by the way? I'm just wondering being a violinist.

Well, I had that violin made by an old man, an old German here whom I met, oh, I guess 25 years ago. Glody. He, he was an old violin maker from Germany. And, and at that time I was doing a lot of teaching and I guess I sold about a half dozen violins which he made. And I still have the same one he made for me. You liked it then? Oh, yes, yes.
I was wondering too now about your orchestra that you had here. Remember those Vocalion and Brunswick records called Elgar's Peel Orchestra?
